defmodule ConversationKit do
  @moduledoc """
  Dependency-free conversation reducer and semantic projections.

  Events are authoritative, ordered JSON data. Intents and speech descriptions are
  data for a host to interpret, never authorization or evidence of execution.
  Temporary progress belongs to a separate, disposable map.
  """

  import Kernel, except: [apply: 2]

  @max_text_bytes 16_000
  @kinds ~w(admitted message settled tool_started tool_finished approval_requested approval_resolved)

  @doc "Construct a conversation; the caller supplies its stable identity."
  def new(id \\ "demo") when is_binary(id) do
    %{
      "id" => id,
      "revision" => 0,
      "events" => [],
      "messages" => [],
      "commands" => %{},
      "tools" => [],
      "approvals" => [],
      "notices" => []
    }
  end

  @doc "Apply one contiguous authoritative event or an exact duplicate."
  def apply(state, event) when is_map(state) do
    cond do
      not valid_event?(event) ->
        {:error, :invalid_event}

      event["revision"] <= state["revision"] ->
        if Enum.at(state["events"], event["revision"] - 1) == event,
          do: {:ok, state},
          else: {:error, :conflicting_duplicate}

      event["revision"] != state["revision"] + 1 ->
        {:error, :revision_gap}

      Enum.any?(state["events"], &(&1["id"] == event["id"])) ->
        {:error, :reused_event_id}

      true ->
        case reduce(state, event["kind"], event["data"]) do
          {:ok, next} ->
            {:ok,
             %{next | "revision" => event["revision"], "events" => state["events"] ++ [event]}}

          error ->
            error
        end
    end
  end

  def apply(_, _), do: {:error, :invalid_state}

  @doc "Replay a batch transactionally: errors never return a partial checkpoint."
  def replay(events, state \\ new())

  def replay(events, state) when is_list(events) do
    Enum.reduce_while(events, {:ok, state}, fn event, {:ok, current} ->
      case apply(current, event) do
        {:ok, next} -> {:cont, {:ok, next}}
        error -> {:halt, error}
      end
    end)
  end

  def replay(_, _), do: {:error, :invalid_events}

  @doc "Closed event validation. Unknown kinds stop replay before cursor advancement."
  def valid_event?(event) do
    exact?(event, ~w(id revision kind data)) and id?(event["id"]) and
      is_integer(event["revision"]) and event["revision"] > 0 and
      event["kind"] in @kinds and valid_data?(event["kind"], event["data"])
  end

  @doc "Project durable state to semantic blocks. Renderers retain native layout and input."
  def project(state) do
    commands =
      state["commands"]
      |> Map.values()
      |> Enum.sort_by(& &1["revision"])

    message_blocks =
      Enum.map(state["messages"], fn message ->
        %{
          "type" => "message",
          "id" => message["id"],
          "text" => message["text"],
          "role" => message["role"],
          "status" => state["commands"][message["command_id"]]["status"]
        }
      end)

    command_blocks =
      commands
      |> Enum.reject(&(&1["status"] == "completed"))
      |> Enum.map(fn command ->
        error = if command["outcome"], do: command["outcome"]["error"], else: nil
        suffix = if error, do: ": " <> error["message"], else: ""

        %{
          "type" => "command",
          "id" => command["id"],
          "status" => command["status"],
          "text" => "Command " <> command["id"] <> ": " <> command["status"] <> suffix
        }
      end)

    tools = Enum.map(state["tools"], &project_activity(state, &1, "running", "active"))

    approvals =
      Enum.map(state["approvals"], &project_activity(state, &1, "pending", "actionable"))

    tool_blocks = Enum.map(tools, &Map.put(&1, "type", "tool"))
    approval_blocks = Enum.map(approvals, &Map.put(&1, "type", "approval"))

    %{
      "id" => state["id"],
      "revision" => state["revision"],
      "messages" => state["messages"],
      "commands" => commands,
      "tools" => tools,
      "approvals" => approvals,
      "notices" => state["notices"],
      "blocks" => message_blocks ++ command_blocks ++ tool_blocks ++ approval_blocks,
      "speech" => speech(state)
    }
  end

  @doc "Normalize a user intent; authoritative events alone change conversation state."
  def intent(state, "send", params) do
    if exact?(params, ["text"]) and text?(params["text"]) and
         String.trim(params["text"]) != "" do
      {:ok, intent_data(state, "chat.send", params)}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_intent}
    end
  end

  def intent(state, "cancel", params) do
    if exact?(params, ["command_id"]) and pending?(state, params["command_id"]) do
      {:ok, intent_data(state, "chat.cancel", params)}
    else
      {:error, :command_not_pending}
    end
  end

  def intent(state, "approve", params) do
    approval =
      if is_map(params),
        do: Enum.find(state["approvals"], &(&1["id"] == params["approval_id"])),
        else: nil

    if exact?(params, ~w(approval_id decision)) and
         params["decision"] in ~w(approved denied) and approval != nil and
         approval["status"] == "pending" and pending?(state, approval["command_id"]) do
      {:ok, intent_data(state, "approval.respond", params)}
    else
      {:error, :approval_not_pending}
    end
  end

  def intent(_, _, _), do: {:error, :unknown_intent}

  @doc "Reduce disposable progress independently of durable conversation revisions."
  def progress(local, update) when is_map(local) do
    if exact?(update, ~w(command_id text)) and id?(update["command_id"]) and
         text?(update["text"]) do
      {:ok, Map.put(local, update["command_id"], update["text"])}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_progress}
    end
  end

  def progress(_, _), do: {:error, :invalid_progress}

  defp intent_data(state, name, params) do
    %{"name" => name, "conversation_id" => state["id"], "input" => params}
  end

  defp reduce(state, "admitted", data) do
    command_id = data["command_id"]

    if Map.has_key?(state["commands"], command_id) do
      {:error, :command_already_admitted}
    else
      command = %{
        "id" => command_id,
        "name" => data["name"],
        "status" => "pending",
        "outcome" => nil,
        "revision" => state["revision"] + 1
      }

      {:ok, %{state | "commands" => Map.put(state["commands"], command_id, command)}}
    end
  end

  defp reduce(state, "message", %{"message" => message}) do
    cond do
      not pending?(state, message["command_id"]) ->
        {:error, :command_not_pending}

      Enum.any?(state["messages"], &(&1["id"] == message["id"])) ->
        {:error, :message_already_exists}

      true ->
        {:ok, %{state | "messages" => state["messages"] ++ [message]}}
    end
  end

  defp reduce(state, "settled", data) do
    command_id = data["command_id"]
    outcome = data["outcome"]

    cond do
      not pending?(state, command_id) ->
        {:error, :command_not_pending}

      outcome["status"] == "completed" and not matching_output?(state, command_id, outcome) ->
        {:error, :completion_without_matching_message}

      true ->
        command = %{
          state["commands"][command_id]
          | "status" => outcome["status"],
            "outcome" => outcome
        }

        {:ok, %{state | "commands" => Map.put(state["commands"], command_id, command)}}
    end
  end

  defp reduce(state, "tool_started", data) do
    cond do
      not pending?(state, data["command_id"]) -> {:error, :command_not_pending}
      Enum.any?(state["tools"], &(&1["id"] == data["id"])) -> {:error, :tool_already_exists}
      true -> {:ok, %{state | "tools" => state["tools"] ++ [Map.put(data, "status", "running")]}}
    end
  end

  defp reduce(state, "tool_finished", data) do
    case Enum.find(state["tools"], &(&1["id"] == data["id"])) do
      %{"status" => "running"} = tool ->
        if pending?(state, tool["command_id"]) do
          tools =
            Enum.map(
              state["tools"],
              &if(&1["id"] == data["id"], do: Map.merge(&1, data), else: &1)
            )

          {:ok, %{state | "tools" => tools}}
        else
          {:error, :command_not_pending}
        end

      _ ->
        {:error, :tool_not_running}
    end
  end

  defp reduce(state, "approval_requested", data) do
    cond do
      not pending?(state, data["command_id"]) ->
        {:error, :command_not_pending}

      Enum.any?(state["approvals"], &(&1["id"] == data["id"])) ->
        {:error, :approval_already_exists}

      true ->
        {:ok,
         %{state | "approvals" => state["approvals"] ++ [Map.put(data, "status", "pending")]}}
    end
  end

  defp reduce(state, "approval_resolved", data) do
    case Enum.find(state["approvals"], &(&1["id"] == data["id"])) do
      %{"status" => "pending"} = approval ->
        if pending?(state, approval["command_id"]) do
          approvals =
            Enum.map(state["approvals"], fn item ->
              if item["id"] == data["id"],
                do: Map.put(item, "status", data["decision"]),
                else: item
            end)

          {:ok, %{state | "approvals" => approvals}}
        else
          {:error, :command_not_pending}
        end

      _ ->
        {:error, :approval_not_pending}
    end
  end

  defp matching_output?(state, command_id, outcome) do
    output = outcome["output"]

    Enum.any?(state["messages"], fn message ->
      message["command_id"] == command_id and message["role"] == "assistant" and
        message["id"] == output["message_id"] and message["text"] == output["text"]
    end)
  end

  defp pending?(state, command_id) do
    case state["commands"][command_id] do
      %{"status" => "pending"} -> true
      _ -> false
    end
  end

  defp project_activity(state, item, open_status, flag) do
    active = item["status"] == open_status and pending?(state, item["command_id"])

    status =
      if item["status"] == open_status and not active, do: "unresolved", else: item["status"]

    item
    |> Map.put("authoritative_status", item["status"])
    |> Map.put("status", status)
    |> Map.put(flag, active)
  end

  defp speech(state) do
    utterances =
      state["messages"]
      |> Enum.filter(fn message ->
        message["role"] == "assistant" and
          state["commands"][message["command_id"]]["status"] == "completed"
      end)
      |> Enum.map(fn message ->
        %{"type" => "utterance", "utterance_id" => message["id"], "text" => message["text"]}
      end)

    escalations =
      state["approvals"]
      |> Enum.filter(fn approval ->
        approval["status"] == "pending" and approval["protected"] and
          pending?(state, approval["command_id"])
      end)
      |> Enum.map(fn approval ->
        %{
          "type" => "screen_required",
          "interaction_id" => approval["id"],
          "text" => "Review the pending approval on screen."
        }
      end)

    utterances ++ escalations
  end

  defp valid_data?("admitted", data),
    do:
      exact?(data, ~w(command_id name)) and id?(data["command_id"]) and
        data["name"] == "chat.send"

  defp valid_data?("message", data),
    do: exact?(data, ["message"]) and valid_message?(data["message"])

  defp valid_data?("settled", data),
    do:
      exact?(data, ~w(command_id outcome)) and id?(data["command_id"]) and
        valid_outcome?(data["outcome"])

  defp valid_data?("tool_started", data),
    do:
      exact?(data, ~w(id command_id name text)) and id?(data["id"]) and id?(data["command_id"]) and
        name?(data["name"]) and text?(data["text"])

  defp valid_data?("tool_finished", data),
    do:
      exact?(data, ~w(id status text)) and id?(data["id"]) and
        data["status"] in ~w(completed failed cancelled) and text?(data["text"])

  defp valid_data?("approval_requested", data),
    do:
      exact?(data, ~w(id command_id text protected)) and id?(data["id"]) and
        id?(data["command_id"]) and text?(data["text"]) and is_boolean(data["protected"])

  defp valid_data?("approval_resolved", data),
    do:
      exact?(data, ~w(id decision)) and id?(data["id"]) and
        data["decision"] in ~w(approved denied)

  defp valid_message?(message) do
    exact?(message, ~w(id role text command_id)) and id?(message["id"]) and
      id?(message["command_id"]) and message["role"] in ~w(user assistant) and
      text?(message["text"])
  end

  defp valid_outcome?(outcome) do
    exact?(outcome, ~w(status output error)) and
      case outcome["status"] do
        "completed" ->
          output = outcome["output"]

          exact?(output, ~w(message_id text)) and id?(output["message_id"]) and
            text?(output["text"]) and outcome["error"] == nil

        status when status in ["failed", "uncertain"] ->
          outcome["output"] == nil and valid_error?(outcome["error"])

        "cancelled" ->
          outcome["output"] == nil and outcome["error"] == nil

        _ ->
          false
      end
  end

  defp valid_error?(error) do
    exact?(error, ~w(code message retryable)) and name?(error["code"]) and
      text?(error["message"]) and is_boolean(error["retryable"])
  end

  defp exact?(map, keys),
    do: is_map(map) and map_size(map) == length(keys) and Enum.all?(keys, &Map.has_key?(map, &1))

  defp text?(value),
    do: is_binary(value) and String.valid?(value) and byte_size(value) <= @max_text_bytes

  defp id?(value),
    do:
      is_binary(value) and byte_size(value) in 1..128 and
        String.match?(value, ~r/\A[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+\z/)

  defp name?(value),
    do:
      is_binary(value) and byte_size(value) in 1..128 and
        String.match?(value, ~r/\A[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*\z/)
end
